drafted_from: tool:check-a-sound-effect-palette row in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/ and tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (run for real on made-up tones)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check my palette folder /work/sfx/palette against PALETTE.json and the licence manifest, and check the music bed is at least 2 seconds." It runs the checker and reads which sounds failed.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads PALETTE.json, the fetcher's manifest.json and the rendered WAV files on this computer and prints a pass or fail.
instructions: 1. Have the rendered palette folder (one <name>.wav per sound), its PALETTE.json and the fetcher's manifest.json (from tool:fetch-free-sound-effects-with-their-licences).

2. Say "Check my palette". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: python3 -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/check_sound_palette.py /work/sfx/PALETTE.json /work/sfx/palette /work/sfx/manifest.json 2 /work/sfx/bed.wav (the 2 and the music files are optional).
3. Read one line per sound (rate, channels, peak, samples, OK or FAIL and what failed), then the last line: result.passed and result.failed. Exit code 1 means something failed.
4. Fix what failed (re-render with tool:make-a-sound-effect-palette, or replace an unlicensed sound) and run it again.

worked_examples.title: A palette of one sound and a 2.2 s music bed passes
worked_examples.ask: Check my palette and my music bed.
worked_examples.given: From tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (test_made_palette_passes_its_check_and_an_unlicensed_or_short_one_fails), run for real: PALETTE.json (rate 48000, channels 2, peak_dbfs -6.0, sound hit with trim [0.05, 0.65], manifest key lib-1); manifest.json {"lib-1": {"file": "x.wav"}}; bed.wav a 2.2 s 48 kHz stereo tone. Command: python3 -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/check_sound_palette.py /work/sfx/PALETTE.json /work/sfx/palette /work/sfx/manifest.json 2 /work/sfx/bed.wav
worked_examples.hands_back: It prints "hit                48000 Hz x2 peak -6.00 dBFS 28800 samples OK", then "/work/sfx/bed.wav: 48000 Hz x2 2.20 s OK", and its last line is {"result": {"passed": true, "failed": []}}. With 5 as the least seconds it exits 1 with {"failed": ["/work/sfx/bed.wav"]}; with a manifest entry {"file": null, "blocked": "not CC0"} it exits 1 with {"failed": ["licensed"]}.
